original: 君子终日乾乾，**夕惕若厉**，无咎。
vernacular_zh: 君子整天勤勉不懈，晚上仍戒惧警惕，如临危境，就没有灾祸。
translation_en: The superior man active and vigilant all the day, and in the evening still careful and apprehensive. (The position is) dangerous, but there will be no mistake.

scripture.text_zh: 务要谨守，儆醒；因为你们的仇敌魔鬼，如同吼叫的狮子，遍地游行，寻找可吞吃的人。
scripture.text_en: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.

insight_zh: 易经：终日乾乾，**警惕时势**；彼得：谨守儆醒，**属灵争战**。
insight_en: I Ching: diligent and **watchful of the times**. Peter: sober and vigilant **in a spiritual battle**.
